subject: Re: after new r release shiny account needs payment

messages.author: 3da48b33a2f506a9
messages.subject: Re: after new r release shiny account needs payment
parts:
Yoni,

You should have received email from RStudio regarding shinyapps.io's end of beta testing period (March 6th). After this date you either need to upgrade your account to a paid plan for extra features, or stick with the free plan which has limited functionalities. Please refer to http://www.rstudio.com/products/shinyapps/ for list of plans and differences.

In your case it seems that you have crossed the max limits of free plan. You could have more than 5 active applications, or you have a private (authorized) application, or some other limitation of free plan.

I have CCed shinyapps.io forum on this email, but in future you can post to that discussion group for faster response:

https://groups.google.com/forum/#!forum/shinyapps-users

Best,
Fereshteh
